title: Hanbit Korea

headings: Want to come, but still have questions?
body: Ten days, moving north to south at walking speed. You'll live in Seoul, Jeonju & Gyeongju, and Busan — a capital that never exhales, two old towns that only exhale, and a port city that smells of salt and grilled eel.
Routes, tickets, timings, the right queue at the right hour — all of it is already solved. We tell you where to stand, what to order, and when to say nothing at all, so you can just be somewhere.
Palace courtyards at opening hour, the print shops of Euljiro, a late bowl of noodles under signage older than we are. One dawn hike up Inwangsan.
A night on a heated floor in a hanok, bibimbap where it was invented, then the Silla tombs and stone pagodas of Gyeongju under falling blossom.
Jagalchi market at 6am, the painted terraces of Gamcheon, a temple built on the rocks above the sea, and two unplanned days that are yours.
Two bilingual guides who grew up here — one in Seoul, one in Busan. They know which stall closes at nine and which monk lets you stay for tea.
Return economy, routed Delhi — Incheon out, Gimhae — Delhi home. No backtracking, no wasted day flying north again.
Airport pickups, the KTX between cities, and a private van for the mountain mornings when the buses don't run early enough.
Twin-share rooms, breakfast in, and one night on a heated hanok floor in Jeonju. Every bed within walking distance of somewhere worth walking to.

notes.concept: A cinematic, scroll-driven landing page for a fictional ten-day curated Korea tour (Seoul → Jeonju & Gyeongju → Busan), built as a single self-contained index.html with zero build step. Every heavy asset — hero plates, hanbok figure cutout, five polaroid video clips, timeline photography, closing cherry-blossom plate — streams through Gumlet (video CDN + image optimisation proxy) from the site's own hosted media, no local asset folder required.
notes.motion: The hero's signature move: the outlined "KOREA" wordmark sits genuinely behind the mountain ridge line, not just under a straight CSS gradient mask. A real alpha silhouette is keyed out of the ridge photograph (sky plate behind the type, ridge silhouette in front of it, hanbok figure on top), so the letterforms read as standing behind the landscape rather than stamped over it. Below the wordmark, a five-card polaroid strip (Gyeongbokgung, an Euljiro alley, Gamcheon's painted terraces, Korean BBQ, a neon Busan street) drifts left at 0.4x scroll speed, each card's muted video playing at full rate on hover.

referenceNotes:
HANBIT KOREA — complete build spec

A cinematic, scroll-driven landing page for a fictional ten-day curated Korea tour
(Seoul → Jeonju & Gyeongju → Busan), built as a single self-contained index.html
with zero build step. Every heavy asset — hero plates, hanbok figure cutout, five
polaroid video clips, timeline photography, closing cherry-blossom plate — streams
through Gumlet (video CDN + image optimisation proxy) from the site's own hosted
media, no local asset folder required.

The hero's signature move: the outlined "KOREA" wordmark sits genuinely behind the
mountain ridge line, not just under a straight CSS gradient mask. A real alpha
silhouette is keyed out of the ridge photograph (sky plate behind the type, ridge
silhouette in front of it, hanbok figure on top), so the letterforms read as
standing behind the landscape rather than stamped over it. Below the wordmark, a
five-card polaroid strip (Gyeongbokgung, an Euljiro alley, Gamcheon's painted
terraces, Korean BBQ, a neon Busan street) drifts left at 0.4x scroll speed, each
card's muted video playing at full rate on hover.

A "jeong / han / meot / nunchi" Hangul concept ribbon separates the hero from the
About section. The About timeline reveals three city clusters (Seoul, Jeonju &
Gyeongju, Busan) in sequence via IntersectionObserver, each with two offset,
slightly rotated photo cards. What's Included is a four-card glass bento grid
plus an explicit "not included" chip row (visas, travel insurance, meals, soju,
souvenirs). The closing section is a full-bleed cherry-blossom-and-pagoda plate
with a frosted-glass request form.

Motion: Lenis smooth scroll (CDN, duration 1.2, exponential-out easing, degrades
gracefully if the CDN is blocked), linear scroll-linked hero parallax (ridge and
type planes at different speeds, polaroid strip at 0.4x), viewport-triggered
timeline stagger, a custom lerped cursor that expands into a ring over interactive
elements, and per-card hover video playback.

Stack: plain static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS. No build step, no framework, no bundler.

## Setup
Create one file named index.html with exactly this content and serve it as a
static file (any static server, e.g. `python3 -m http.server`). Needs internet —
every image and video streams from Gumlet.
